definitions.explanation: A book that someone loves and reads repeatedly. Often used when talking about books that have had a deep personal impact.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛読書|あいどくしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧です。
examples.english: This novel is my favorite book.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛読書|あいどくしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{読|よ}み{返|かえ}した→読み返す：07954_yomikaesu⟧。
examples.english: I reread a favorite book from my childhood for the first time in a long while.

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛読書|あいどくしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}かれて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{答|こた}えられなかった→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: When asked what my favorite book was, I couldn't answer right away.

notes:
USAGE:
{愛読書|あいどくしょ} implies a book that someone has read multiple times and holds in high regard. It is a common question in interviews and self-introductions in Japan.

FORMS:
⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (love) + ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧ (reading/book) — literally a book one loves to read.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {愛読書|あいどくしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (What is your favorite book?)
- ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛読書|あいどくしょ} (a long-time favorite book)

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{愛読|あいどく}→愛読：15980_aidoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to read regularly and with fondness
- ⟦{愛用|あいよう}→愛用：12693_aiyou⟧: regularly used (for items)
